package bootstrap

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	monster "example.com/planet/game/entities/monster"
	scene "example.com/planet/game/entities/scene"
	gameheartbeat "example.com/planet/game/heartbeat"
	registry "example.com/planet/internal/registry"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine/engine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	corenest "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	kitheartbeat "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/wiring/heartbeat"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/wiring/mods"
	kitnest "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/wiring/nest"
)

// 生成工程的心跳端到端（scripts/test-heartbeat-generated.sh）：roost add behavior --ai --state / heartbeat / timedomain
// 生成的组件，经与生成 bootstrap 同样构造的 Nest Mod 与 heartbeat Mod、真实 Nest 引擎与心跳驱动循环运行。
// DataEngine 换成不落库的 committer，实体只新建、不冷加载（loader 一律 not found）。

type noDurableStore struct{}

func (noDurableStore) NestOptions() []corenest.NestOption {
	return []corenest.NestOption{corenest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(noDurableStore{})}
}
func (noDurableStore) Commit(context.Context, corenest.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

type nothingStored struct{}

func (nothingStored) LoadEntity(context.Context, int64, entity.EntityKind) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	return nil, engine.ErrEntityAggregateNotFound
}

func TestGeneratedHeartbeatBehaviorEndToEnd(t *testing.T) {
	if err := registry.RegisterAll(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := EntityAccess.ConfigureLoader(nothingStored{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg := viper.New()
	reg := app.NewRegistry(cfg)
	if err := reg.Register(mods.ModDataEngine, noDurableStore{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// 与生成的 bootstrap 同样的两个构造。
	nestMod := kitnest.NewMod(EntityAccess)
	heartbeatMod := kitheartbeat.NewMod(EntityAccess, gameheartbeat.Driver)
	all := []app.Mod{nestMod, heartbeatMod}
	for _, mod := range all {
		if err := mod.Init(cfg); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s init: %v", mod.Name(), err)
		}
	}
	for _, mod := range all {
		if err := mod.Provide(reg); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s provide: %v", mod.Name(), err)
		}
	}
	for _, mod := range all {
		if err := mod.Start(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s start: %v", mod.Name(), err)
		}
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_ = heartbeatMod.StopWithContext(ctx)
		_ = nestMod.StopWithContext(ctx)
	})
	nest, ok := app.Lookup[*corenest.NestMgr](reg, mods.ModNest)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("nest engine not published")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	request := func(handler string, id int64, params ...any) any {
		t.Helper()
		value, err := nest.Request(ctx, corenest.NewHandlerName(handler), id, corenest.NewParams(params...))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", handler, err)
		}
		return value
	}
	waitFor := func(what string, cond func() bool) {
		t.Helper()
		deadline := time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second)
		for !cond() {
			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
				t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for %s (driver %+v)", what, gameheartbeat.Driver.Stats())
			}
			time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
	create := func(kind entity.EntityKind, unique int64) int64 {
		t.Helper()
		created, err := EntityAccess.Create(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, UniqueID: unique, Kind: kind, Category: entity.MustEntityCategoryOfKind(kind)})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return created.ID()
	}

	// 1. 新建的实体没有在跳的登记（示例心跳停着、行为组件空闲、AI 没有策略）：不占调度。
	monsterID := create(monster.EntityKindMonster, 7)
	sceneID := create(scene.EntityKindScene, 1)
	if got := gameheartbeat.Driver.Registered(); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("idle entities hold %d running registrations, want 0", got)
	}

	// 2. 生成的示例 handler 发起示例动作：主组的心跳（100ms 档）推进它，满 500ms 成功结束，组空闲后心跳停。
	executedBefore := gameheartbeat.Driver.Stats().Executed
	if id := request("handlerStartExampleMonsterAction", monsterID, int64(500)).(int64); id <= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("example action id = %d", id)
	}
	progress := func() string { return request("handlerMonsterExampleProgress", monsterID).(string) }
	var lastRunning string
	waitFor("the heartbeat to tick the example action", func() bool {
		p := progress()
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "running") && !strings.HasPrefix(p, "running ticks=0 ") {
			lastRunning = p
			return true
		}
		return false
	})
	waitFor("the example action to finish", func() bool {
		p := progress()
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "running") {
			lastRunning = p
		}
		return p == "idle started=0"
	})
	waitFor("the idle group to stop its heartbeat", func() bool { return gameheartbeat.Driver.Registered() == 0 })
	stats := gameheartbeat.Driver.Stats()
	if beats := stats.Executed - executedBefore; beats < 4 {
		t.Fatalf("the 500ms example action finished after %d executed beats (last seen %q), want at least 4 at 100ms", beats, lastRunning)
	}
	t.Logf("example action: last progress %q, executed beats %d, stats %+v", lastRunning, stats.Executed-executedBefore, stats)

	// 3. AI：设定示例策略后 AI 心跳（500ms）决策，主组空闲就发起 1s 的示例动作，动作由主组心跳推进，结束后再发起下一个。
	if name := request("handlerStartExampleMonsterStrategy", monsterID).(string); name != "example" {
		t.Fatalf("strategy = %q", name)
	}
	waitFor("the AI to start a second example action after the first one ended", func() bool {
		var started int
		p := progress()
		_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(p[strings.Index(p, "started="):], "started=%d", &started)
		return started >= 2
	})

	// 4. 场景：示例心跳 Start 之后由驱动执行；时间域 SetRate 提交后发布，存进 nopersist,sync 字段。
	executedBefore = gameheartbeat.Driver.Stats().Executed
	request("handlerSceneStartExampleBeat", sceneID)
	waitFor("the scene's example beat to run", func() bool { return gameheartbeat.Driver.Stats().Executed >= executedBefore+2 })
	request("handlerSceneSetRate", sceneID, 2.0)
	live, ok := EntityManager.Get(sceneID).(*scene.Scene)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("scene is not loaded")
	}
	if got := live.TimeDomainComp().Domain().State().EffectiveRate(); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("published rate = %v, want 2", got)
	}
	if err := nest.RunLocal(ctx, func() {
		if got := live.Dao().GetTimeRate(); got != 2 {
			t.Errorf("TimeRate field = %v, want 2", got)
		}
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := nest.Request(ctx, corenest.NewHandlerName("handlerSceneSetRate"), sceneID, corenest.NewParams(9.0)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("a rate outside timeDomainConfig was accepted")
	}
}
